title: Smart-meter config store: quorum reads during a replica outage
name: Quorum config store

questions.prompt: Incident report: when replica a lost power, a few thousand smart meters downgraded themselves. Some went back to the firmware from before last week's rollout, and some went all the way back to factory 1.0.0. Writes during the outage failed loudly as expected, but reads never reported an error. The store runs with N=3, W=2, R=2, so a single replica failure should be invisible. Fix replication/quorum.ts so the tests pass.
